runtime: Java 21, DJL 0.40.4 ROCm snapshot, PyTorch 2.11.0 ROCm 7.2.2
decision: Adopt default microBatchSize 1024 for newly initialized models, keep global batch 1024. Limit effective microbatch by ceil(logical rows / device count) to retain multi-device partitioning. Existing runs/checkpoints are unchanged.
collectionScope: At the measured baseline, the collection default was 32768 trajectories per iteration: HAND_GRP meant hands and MATCH_MC meant full matches. The current implementation collects 32768 full matches in both modes. This historical learner-only benchmark uses the same saved 4096-hand corpus, without new collection.
timingScope: Sum of work divided by sum of measured seconds. Includes sampling, payload/observation decoding, transfer, forward/backward, optimizer and checkpoint/GPU synchronization every 32 updates. Excludes corpus preparation, model load and 8 warmup updates. The per-process device VRAM peaks include all phases.
numericalScope: Local comparisons reset parameters and optimizer before each paired update, and all 24 paired updates pass existing BF16 criteria. Cross-micro cumulative comparisons fail the 3% update relative L2 criterion by step 6, but same-micro 512-vs-512 controls also fail and show larger final differences. Failures are retained. This does not prove long-term playing-strength equivalence or improved numerical stability.

average-weighted-m1024-1.timingScope: Headline samples/s includes replay sampling and payload decode, CfrModel.train including observation decode, bucket assignment, CPU preparation, transfer, forward/backward/optimizer, and periodic saveTraining including deferred GPU synchronization. Checkpoints are saved every configured interval and at window end. Internal decode cannot be separated through the public model API; the reported corpusDecodeDiagnosticSeconds is separate setup work, not a subtraction from learner time. Unique processed rows sum within-update distinct identities. Sampling mode is reported separately; uniform-distinct is a compute diagnostic, not production weighted training. Stored teachers and weights are unchanged. Warmup, model/replay load, and corpus preparation are reported separately.
